sources.title: Return policy
sources.text:
# Return policy

We want you to be happy with every purchase. Rules differ by product type.

## Electronics

Electronics can be returned within 10 days of delivery, only if the manufacturer's seal is intact. Opened electronics are handled through the brand's service centre.

## Groceries

Packaged groceries can be returned within 7 days if unopened. Fresh milk, fruits and vegetables cannot be returned, but damaged items are replaced the same day.

## Furniture

Furniture cannot be returned. You can exchange it within 3 days for a different size or colour, if it is unused.

## Clothing

Clothing can be returned within 15 days with the original tags attached. Innerwear cannot be returned.

## Refunds

Refunds are credited to the original payment method within 5 working days of pickup.

sources.title: Store FAQ
sources.text:
Delivery:
We deliver within 5 km of Indiranagar. Orders above ₹499 are delivered free; below that the delivery charge is ₹40. Furniture delivery takes 3 to 5 days.

Payment:
UPI, cards and cash on delivery. Cash on delivery is not available for furniture.

Store hours:
Monday to Saturday 9am to 9pm. Sunday 10am to 6pm.
